name: Generate multilingual vocabulary lists and glossaries
description: Users asked to generate multilingual vocabulary lists, glossaries, or flashcards, frequently mixing Japanese, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese, and other languages. The requests often involved specifying formats such as tables, flashcard structures, or trilingual definitions, and focused on domains like occupational safety, legal procedures, or general high-frequency terms, with some requests asking for simplified or child-friendly explanations.
